name: sales
description: Handles sales enquiries including needs discovery and recommendations.

steps.prompt: What type of vehicle or service are you interested in?
Do you have a budget range in mind?
What will you mainly use the vehicle for? (commuting, family, long-distance, city driving)
Do you have any preferences such as electric, hybrid, fuel type, or size?
Thanks, I have a good picture of what you're looking for. I can suggest a few suitable vehicle profiles or connect you with a sales advisor.
